business_summary: Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan. The company operates in Construction, Civil Engineering, and Real Estate Segments It is involved in designing and construction of various architectures such as condominiums for rental purpose, buildings, factories and condominiums for senior citizens with care services; renovation, repairs and building maintenance; administration of buildings and condominiums, as well as overall real estate business; high end exclusive furniture, design and construction of renovation of residential and commercial facilities. The company also offers design and construction of shrines, temples and religious facilities; repairs and refurbishment of national treasures and important cultural architecture; wooden detached housing business, wooden apartment business, and wooden land utilization business. In addition, it designs, constructs, and renovates business of condominiums, offices, and stores; manufacturing facilities, warehouses, hotels, data centers, remodeling, PFI-related projects; excavation, research, analysis and preservation of archaeological resources; harbor, marine and environment protection civil engineering, designing and construction of residential, cultural and business-related facilities. Further, the company offers reclamation, dredging, harbor and river civil engineering, maritime logistics; slope protection, ground improvement, blasting construction, cooling and fireproofing utilities; sales of fireproof materials; property development; and real estate and investment operations on single-family and multifamily residential properties. Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd.는 일본에서 건설 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 건설, 토목 엔지니어링 및 부동산 부문을 운영하고 있습니다. 임대용 콘도미니엄, 건물, 공장, 돌봄 서비스가 제공되는 노인용 콘도미니엄 등 다양한 건축물의 설계 및 건설에 참여하고 있습니다. 개조, 수리 및 건물 유지 관리; 건물 및 콘도 관리, 부동산 사업 전반; 고급 고급 가구, 주거 및 상업 시설 개조 설계 및 시공. 이 회사는 또한 신사, 사원 및 종교 시설의 설계 및 건설도 제공합니다. 국보 및 중요 문화 건축물의 수리 및 개조; 목조단독주택사업, 목조아파트사업, 목조토지이용사업 등이 있습니다. 또한 콘도미니엄, 사무실, 상점 등의 비즈니스를 설계, 건설 및 개조합니다. 제조 시설, 창고, 호텔, 데이터 센터, 리모델링, PFI 관련 프로젝트; 고고학 자원의 발굴, 연구, 분석 및 보존; 항만, 해양 및 환경 보호 토목 엔진
